links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified ICU discharge summary sections from MIMIC-III
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease rose from 51.2 ± 6.1 to 58.3–60.3; grade level fell from 9.4 ± 1.2 to 7.6–8.0 (all p < 0.0001)
links.tradeoff: Simplification carried omission risk: the best automated configuration (GPT-4o few-shot) still had 2.2% medication omission and 0.4% diagnosis omission. The authors state that patient-facing use needs section-aware constraints, explicit safety checks and human oversight.
links.quote: All six prompting conditions significantly improved readability versus the original notes (all p < 0.0001), increasing Flesch Reading Ease from 51.2 ± 6.1 to 58.3–60.3 and reducing grade level from 9.4 ± 1.2 to 7.6–8.0.

links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting (and chain-of-thought prompting) with GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini
links.outcome: Automated balance of simplification and preservation (similarity, lexical overlap, medication and diagnosis omission); blinded human faithfulness, readability and actionability
links.effect: GPT-4o few-shot: similarity 0.844 ± 0.071, lexical overlap 0.638 ± 0.072, medication omission 2.2%, diagnosis omission 0.4%; best combined human-rated faithfulness, readability and actionability
links.quote: GPT-4o few-shot provided the strongest automated overall balance of simplification and preservation (similarity 0.844 ± 0.071, lexical overlap 0.638 ± 0.072, medication omission 2.2%, diagnosis omission 0.4%).

links.comparator_used: Zero-shot and few-shot prompting without stepwise reasoning
links.outcome: Blinded human-rated faithfulness and hallucination; combined faithfulness, readability and actionability
links.effect: GPT-4o with chain-of-thought achieved perfect faithfulness and 0% hallucination, but GPT-4o few-shot had the best combined faithfulness, readability and actionability
links.quote: In blinded human evaluation, GPT-4o with chain-of-thought prompting achieved perfect faithfulness and 0% hallucination, while GPT-4o few-shot showed the best combined faithfulness, readability, and actionability.

design_hint: prompting strategy (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought) for readability and safety
